full_page.content:
May 12, c. 1947
The following is the faithful transcription of the handwritten original by the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey, O.F.M. Cap.
Miss Margaret Haf. 18979 Littlefield Ave. Detroit 35, Michigan Un 2 4512
Bles'd be God in all His designs! May 12-
Surely it is a promisin turn in the outlook for a five- year paralytic. Their fraternal-Christian interest as shown in response to the Chaplain's appeal for a so helpless sister-Mrs. Mary O.D., is surely to the high credit of the Boys in Cap (at the Gross Ille Base").
If every one of Mary's friends do what they can to please God and to sanctify their own souls, God in His merciful wisdom and power will give them the surprise of their life.
Fr. Solanus, ofm, Cap.
Original in possession of:
Miss Margaret E. Haf
24 13 Coolidge #203
Troy, Mi. 48084
